analysis.title: Dirt Cheap AI The Opportunity Nobody Wants To Touch
key_insights: JPM's aggregate Asian equity positioning indicator has fallen to the 8th percentile, a level that has historically coincided with important market bottoms. Asian equities had another roughly 15% monthly drawdown and tech RSI readings are in the low 20s.

Asia's price momentum factor has fallen 45% from its June highs, approaching the size of the 1998-99 and 2009 reversals. JPM suggests growing leverage at multi-strategy and quantitative investors may be amplifying the moves.
KOSPI trades well below its 200-day moving average. The note says an oversold bounce could be violent, but it also flags a death cross as real technical damage.

SK Hynix is down almost 30% in a month. JPM's screen puts it at 2.3x forward earnings with a projected two-year EPS CAGR of 193.6%. JPM estimates cumulative 2026-28 free cash flow will exceed the current market cap.

Goldman data cited in the note show Korean semiconductor valuations back at levels rarely seen in modern market history. The market is pricing a structural earnings downturn rather than a temporary correction.

Asian tech earnings revision breadth remains positive. JPM's technology analysts see none of the classic cycle-ending signals: inventory accumulation, shortening lead times or aggressive capacity expansion.

JPM names corporates, long-only funds and pensions as potential buyers in Korea, and hedge funds and ETFs as potential support in Taiwan. Institutional AI exposure has been reduced, but retail and high-net-worth positioning remains elevated.

JPM's read is a violent deleveraging event inside an intact AI supercycle, not the end of the cycle. The Market Ear frames the setup as a potential squeeze if institutional buying absorbs the remaining retail selling.

market_movers.rationale: SK Hynix is down almost 30% in a month and trades at 2.3x forward earnings on JPM's screen, with projected two-year EPS CAGR of 193.6%. JPM estimates 2026-28 cumulative free cash flow will exceed its market cap.

sector_views.rationale: Valuations are depressed, earnings revision breadth is positive and positioning is near capitulation. JPM sees no cycle-ending signals in inventory, lead times or capacity.

earnings_insights: Asian tech earnings revision breadth remains positive despite the price correction (JPM).
SK Hynix: JPM's screen shows 2.3x forward earnings and a projected two-year EPS CAGR of 193.6%. These are JPM estimates, not reported figures.
risk_factors: The positioning unwind is feeding on itself, with multi-strategy and quant leverage amplifying the moves.
KOSPI's death cross is real technical damage, and the next move could be explosive in either direction.
Retail and high-net-worth positioning remains elevated. If institutional buyers cannot absorb retail liquidation, the selling could continue.
The market may be correctly pricing a structural earnings downturn in Korean semiconductors.

Multi-strategy and tech-focused hedge funds have substantially reduced exposure. Retail and high-net-worth AI positioning remains elevated.
Asia's momentum factor is down 45% from its June highs, close to the 1998-99 and 2009 reversals. Growing multi-strategy and quant leverage may be amplifying the unwind.
Tech RSI readings are in the low 20s, and KOSPI is below its 200-day moving average. The squeeze potential is described as enormous.
cross_bank_references: Valuation reset across Korean semiconductors has pushed multiples back toward levels rarely seen in modern market history, according to Goldman.
